disclaimer: This is a personal diary, not a medical service. It is not a diagnosis or treatment. Discuss results with your doctor.
verify_required: Please verify your email first (we sent a link).
verify_success: Email verified. You can log in.
upload_first_hint: Upload PDF or photos. Smart AI detects draw dates and markers — then review, attach to an existing draw or create a new one, and confirm.
upload_batch_hint: You can upload up to {max} files at once. Reading runs on the server — you may close this tab and return later.
import_files_step_hint: Verify Smart AI read each file correctly. Biomarkers here are read-only — edit them on the draws step. You can re-read with a hint, or delete a file.
import_draws_step_hint: Data from files are merged by draw date. Edit values and confirm.
import_continue_while_running_hint: More files may still be running — you can continue with what is ready.
import_progress_failed: Reading the report failed. Try Classic mode or a smaller batch.
import_progress_server_hint: Processing runs on the server. You can close this tab — the job continues in the background.
import_file_errors_title: Some files could not be read (you can still review the rest):
import_reextract_hint: Describe what is wrong or how to read the document (columns = dates, missing marker, wrong value…). AI re-reads only this file.
import_reextract_placeholder: e.g. 3 draw columns (14 Oct 2020, 18 May 2016, 14 Sep 2010); ferritin missing; glucose is 5.4 mmol/l in the middle column; ignore order form / checkboxes…
import_retry_while_running_hint: You can queue other failed files now — no need to wait for the current one.
import_review_while_running_hint: Remaining files keep processing — confirm as you go.
import_review_partial_title: Partial review — more files still loading
import_review_partial_hint: Confirm results that are ready. When more files finish, return via Files, then come back here.
upload_extends_hint: Upload new reports via Upload report — the system assigns them to draws by date.
existing_draw_hint: You already have a draw on this day with the same lab.
pick_existing_or_new: Pick an existing draw, or create a new one.
split_selected: Split selected into a new draw
split_selected_hint: Use when results were merged by mistake.
merge_draw_hint: Move selected values, or merge all results (+ files) into another draw. Duplicates are skipped.
merge_draw_confirm: Merge this whole draw into the selected one? Empty source will be deleted.
no_other_draws: No other draw available to move/merge into.
conditions_create_hint: Fill in context for this draw (fasting, weight, training, sleep, illness…) — helps interpret results and trends. You can leave fields empty or skip.
conditions_edit_hint: Conditions already exist for this draw — review or change them. Or keep unchanged and continue.
trends_empty: No confirmed results for charts yet.
trends_all_hint: All markers with data, grouped logically. Green band = tip (fixed). Red stepped line = lab range per draw (can change over time).
trends_table_hint: All values in canonical units (same as charts). Lab = report range, tip = guide band. Date links to the draw.
edit_results_hint: Save value, unit, lab range and note with the Save button on each row.
delete_account_confirm: Really delete account? This cannot be undone.
import_remove_file_confirm: Really delete this file and its proposed results from review?
import_file_markers_empty: No measured results (not a lab report, or nothing extracted).
discard_document_confirm: Really discard this document? The file and proposed results will be deleted.
extract_classic: Classic (on-server, free) — text OCR only, no AI; manual editing needed
smart_consent: I agree to send this report to NVIDIA NIM for analysis
smart_unavailable: Smart AI is not available right now. Try again later.
multi_date_hint: Multiple draw dates detected. Confirming will create separate draws per date.
